node_type.title: Node Type
node_type.description: Type of node this template represents. Must be one of 'source', 'destination', 'transform'.

node_name.title: Node Name
node_name.description: Name of the new node template. Whitespace-only names are rejected.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description of the template.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label for this config item.

value.title: Value
value.description: Current value of this config item.

field_type.title: Field Type
field_type.description: UI field type used to render this config item, if specified.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what this config item controls.

list_options.title: List Options
list_options.description: Allowed choices when this item is a selectable list, if applicable.

field.title: Field
field.description: Name of the other config field this item depends on.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value the referenced field must have for this item to apply.

depends_on.description: Conditional dependency that determines whether this item applies.

config.title: Config
config.description: Configuration items copied from the source node into the template.

include_samples.title: Include Samples
include_samples.description: Whether to copy the node's sample messages into the template. Off by default - a sample is a message someone captured to test against, so it may hold real data.
